تعتذرن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَذِرْنَ (taʕtaḏirna) /taʕ.ta.ðir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# تُعْتَذَرْنَ (tuʕtaḏarna) /tuʕ.ta.ðar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
